sites.name: Ha Long Bay
sites.event: A UNESCO World Natural Heritage site, one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature, associated with the legend of the Mother Dragon descending to earth.

place.district: Ha Long City (and Cam Pha City, Van Don District)

sites.name: Yen Tu Scenic Area and Relic Complex
sites.event: The ideological capital of Vietnamese Buddhism, where King-Monk Tran Nhan Tong practiced asceticism and founded the Truc Lam Yen Tu Zen Sect.

sites.name: Bach Dang Stake Yard
sites.event: A special national relic site, marking 3 glorious naval battles in the history of fighting foreign invaders (in 938, 981, and 1288).

place.commune: Yen Giang Ward, Nam Hoa Ward...

sites.name: Cua Ong Temple (Cua Suot Temple)
sites.event: The place of worship for Hung Nhuong Vuong Tran Quoc Tang (the 3rd son of Tran Hung Dao), who guarded the Northeast region.

sites.name: Co To Island
sites.event: The only place where Uncle Ho agreed to have his statue erected during his lifetime (in 1961).

place.commune: Co To Town (and Dong Tien, Thanh Lan communes)

sites.name: Sa Vi Cape (Got Cape)
sites.event: The very first point where the pen stroke started to draw the S-shaped map of Vietnam (Northeast Pole).

sites.name: Bai Tho Mountain
sites.event: The limestone mountain preserving poems carved on the cliff by King Le Thanh Tong (in 1468) and Lord Trinh Cuong (in 1729).

sites.name: Tran Dynasty Relic Complex in Dong Trieu
sites.event: The ancestral homeland of the Tran Dynasty, home to the tombs of the Tran kings and An Sinh Temple, which worships 8 Tran kings.

place.commune: An Sinh Commune, Trang An Commune, Thuy An Commune...

sites.name: Dinosaur Backbone (Binh Lieu)
sites.event: A majestic border patrol route with vast fields of reeds, leading to landmark 1305.

place.commune: Hoanh Mo Commune, Dong Van Commune

sites.name: Cai Bau Pagoda (Truc Lam Giac Tam Zen Monastery)
sites.event: Built on the foundation of the Phuc Linh Tu Pagoda dating back to the Tran Dynasty, it boasts a beautiful 'leaning on the mountain, facing the sea' position.

sites.name: Bai Tu Long Bay
sites.event: Associated with the legend of a flock of baby dragons descending to help the people fight invaders, featuring a pristine landscape no less spectacular than Ha Long Bay.

place.commune: The sea area of Cam Pha, Van Don
place.district: Cam Pha City, Van Don District

sites.name: Tra Co Communal House
sites.event: One of the largest and most architecturally unique ancient communal houses in the Northern region, a cultural landmark on the border ('Communal house of the sea village').
